typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	,MEMBER_NAME 	,MARKET 	,PRODUCT 	,UNITJOB_NAME 	,CALLLIST_CD 	,NUMBER_CALLED 	,PHONESOURCE_CD 	,HH_MEMBER 	,CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT 	,CALL_DATE 	,ATTEMPTS 	,AGENT_ID 	,AGENT 	,DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD 	,DISPOSITION 	,APP_SIGN_DT 	,MEMBER_LANGUAGE 	,CASE_ID 	,USER_TYPE FROM [dbo].[PDS_ONCOLOGY_NAVIGATOR_CALL_ATTEMPTS_342]  WHERE UNITJOB_NAME= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		HH_MEMBER as string,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT_ID as string,
		MARKET as string,
		UNITJOB_NAME as string,

		APP_SIGN_DT as string,
		AGENT as string,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,

		PRODUCT as string,

		ATTEMPTS as integer,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE as string,
		CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NUMBER_CALLED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		HH_MEMBER,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD,
		MEMBER_NAME,
		AGENT_ID,
		MARKET,
		UNITJOB_NAME,
		PHONESOURCE_CD,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		DISPOSITION,
		APP_SIGN_DT,
		AGENT,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		CASE_ID,
		PRODUCT,
		CALL_DATE,
		USER_TYPE,
		ATTEMPTS,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE,
		CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT,
		NUMBER_CALLED)) ~> FlatFileDestination
